description: The first exam to run: two scripted tasks against a tiny TypeScript CLI, no model and no key, so the loop and the report can be seen before anything real is measured.

assistant.about: who answers: nb on its Mock provider, which reads its script from the prompt, so no model is called

mock.note: nb on its Mock provider, which answers from a script in the prompt

stages.about: The scripted model answers in one turn; the repository's build and tests are checked afterwards
The scripted model builds the CLI and runs it once with bash, then answers OK
stages.prompt: MOCK:tool=bash npm ci --silent --no-audit --no-fund && npm run -s build && node dist/src/cli.js list
